honest_wall: BSD is a conjecture (not proven for all curves). This verifies the APPROACH to s=1 via L(1+eps,E) for specific curves. The Euler product converges absolutely for Re(s)>3/2, so at s=1+eps with small eps it is a good approximation. Rank-0 curves show L(1+eps) stabilizing; rank-1 curves show L(1+eps)->0. Computing L'(1) or the full BSD formula (involving Sha, regulator, torsion) is beyond this probe.
